description: How much of the Taiwan stock market foreign and mainland-China investors own, from the TWSE QFII register — either the securities with the highest overseas ownership and their remaining headroom under the statutory ceiling, or ownership share broken down by sector. Answers "how much of TSMC do foreigners own", "foreign ownership of Taiwanese banks".

mode.description: top_holdings = the most foreign-owned securities. by_industry = ownership share per sector. Default top_holdings.
